description: This file declares the KinetoEdgeCPUProfiler class used for profiling KINETO events within the torch::jit::mobile namespace. It includes methods for starting/stopping profiling, recording backend events, and managing profiler results. The class depends on external Kineto and torch modules and is conditionally compiled if USE_KINETO is defined.

classes.name: KinetoEdgeCPUProfiler
classes.description: A profiler class for capturing KINETO events related to a specific mobile Module, with configurable options for input shapes, memory profiling, stack traces, flops, and module hierarchy.

methods.name: KinetoEdgeCPUProfiler
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the profiler with profiling options and target module.

methods.name: disableProfiler
methods.description: Disables the profiler and returns the profiling results.

methods.name: recordBackendEvent
methods.description: Records a backend event with timing and naming details.

methods.name: recordBackendMemoryEvent
methods.description: Records a backend memory event with pointer, size, and device info.

methods.name: ~KinetoEdgeCPUProfiler
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the profiler instance.
